card.title: Acceleration
card.says: how much an object's **velocity** changes each second — in speed, in direction, or both.
card.from: the definition of the rate of change of velocity between an initial velocity $\vec{u}$ and a final velocity $\vec{v}$ over time $\Delta t$.
card.useWhen: velocity is changing (speeding up, slowing down, or turning). If $\vec{a}$ points opposite to $\vec{v}$, the object slows down.
card.example: A car accelerates in a straight line from $u = 10\text{ m/s}$ to $v = 26\text{ m/s}$ in $\Delta t = 4\text{ s}$ → $a = \dfrac{26 - 10}{4} = \dfrac{16}{4} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$ forward.
card.analogy: If velocity is how fast your savings grow per month, acceleration is how much bigger your monthly deposit gets each month.

aliases: ความเร่งเฉลี่ย
